summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests or repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the title sequence formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/_windows_renderer.py calls term.set_title with the control's second item; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True when written and False otherwise; CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only, mocked). Nothing was committed. Black formatting was checked by hand, not by running Black.
